name: Open Ephemeris
description: Sub-arcsecond astrology and astronomy from the NASA JPL DE440 ephemeris: natal, synastry, progressions, transit search, moon phases, eclipses, Human Design, Vedic, BaZi and astrocartography. Interactive charts render inline in hosts that support MCP Apps. Also a one-click app in the ChatGPT app directory and a connector for Claude.
author: Open Ephemeris
